nodes.label: Burger Dome · 2 servers
nodes.detail: One shared FIFO line; next available server
nodes.notes: Figure 11.3 structure: one waiting line feeding two parallel homogeneous servers; each customer uses just one server. Numerical assumption inherited from the prior single-server classroom example: exponential arrivals 45/hour (mean interarrival 4/3 minutes), exponential service 60/hour PER server (mean 1 minute). The two-server figure itself does not specify rates. Start empty, infinite queue, independent streams, no warm-up deletion. M/M/2 benchmark: P0=5/11; Pw=9/44; Lq=27/220; L=48/55; Wq=9/55 minutes; W=64/55 minutes; utilization=.375. Simulation results will vary from steady state.
